about: Why a proof that failed failed, after looking at the code and the careers: a game gap (open or fixed), a career the proof doesn't reach yet, or a measure that doesn't see the effect. Read by tests/v10-features.test.ts into FEATURES.md.
ask-better-rate: Career not reached: a request for a better rate is agreed only for an agent's client or a player graded Established, which two-year careers rarely are; to prove with the agent's careers.
cash-withdrawal: Game gap, open, the owner's to decide: cash is spent only on everyday living, which SLATE left out.
credit-card: Game gap, open, the owner's to decide: a card pays only for everyday living, which SLATE left out.
finance-target: Measure: a higher target raises more from backers (backer money in moves), and their repayment's effect on money is inside the seeds' spread at 30 seeds; to run with 100.
first-look-overhead: Measure: asking for more overhead moves money by about $117,000 a career, inside the seeds' spread at 30 seeds; to run with 100.
lead-role-size: Game gap, open: a lead part asks and costs what a supporting one does; only awards placement reads it.
off-audience-week: Measure: the weeks a release is watched move revenue inside the seeds' spread; to run with 100.
off-edition-announce: By design: the results step announces an edition first where no announcement ran (awards-results.ts editionResults), so switching announcements off changes when a selection is known, not what it is; the career measures after both.
off-edition-results: Career not reached: the careers' shorts almost never reach a final result to win or lose; to prove with careers whose work is selected for competitive categories.
off-edition-start: Career not reached: a festival's opening runs its screenings and juries, which the careers' shorts rarely reach.
off-first-look-check: Career not reached: the scheduled check needs studios, which this probe's careers don't have (the first-look probes do).
off-job-lapse: Measure: unanswered offers stay open when lapsing is off (direct effect seen); no later system counts open offers.
off-opportunity-expire: Measure: unanswered opportunities stay open when expiry is off (direct effect seen); no career here answers or counts them later.
off-opportunity: Career not reached: an opportunity is a project offered after well-received work; no career here accepts one, so nothing follows it.
off-screening: Career not reached: a screening a player attends is RSVPed; no career here RSVPs.
off-shoot-call: Career not reached: the call checks the player is there and allowed to work; in a career at home they always are. Proven through work-permit, abroad.
off-weather-check: By design: the check is the forecast's warning; days are lost to the weather on the day (runShootDay), not by the warning. Its effect is through what the player does with it (weather-move, weather-keep).
rehearsal-days: Game gap, fixed November 14, 2026: rehearsal reached only the player's own performance; this result predates the fix.
runtime-longer: Game gap, open: once scenes are written the target runtime is read only to place a series in half-hour or hour award classes; production follows the scenes.
scene-essential: Measure: a cut essential scene costs the edit 8 points (seen); the overall score moves inside the seeds' spread.
scene-minutes: Measure: longer scenes cost more and take longer (seen); money and revenue move inside the seeds' spread.
shelve-resume: Measure: shelving delays delivery (seen) and costs money and revenue on average, inside the seeds' spread at 30 seeds; to run with 100.
six-day-weeks: Measure: six-day weeks deliver sooner (seen); later effects inside the seeds' spread.
weather-swap: Career not reached: the careers' shorts have no interior day after a rained-on exterior to swap with.
work-permit: Game gap, fixed November 14, 2026: the shoot could start before a place's permits were done, so the careers' films abroad were lost either way; this result predates the fix.
